rules.conflict: height disagreement > 15% or pair IoU < 0.5 keeps both values
rules.footprint: PLATEAU authoritative when matched (IoU >= 0.5), else single source
rules.height_ladder: PLATEAU measuredHeight (authoritative_observed) > OSM height tag (directly_observed) > TMG 2023 LiDAR p90 roof when the roof field shows a structure (median >= 2 m; directly_observed) > OSM building:levels x 3 m (derived) > locale prior (synthetic)
rules.lidar_contradiction: a footprint whose 2023 roof field shows no raised structure keeps its geometry and carries a dated contradiction; nothing is deleted
rules.street: OSM owns position when a same-class OSM point lies within the rules merge budget, else the Mapillary point with sigma prior; past-budget candidates keep a spatial_reconciliation_debt claim, never a blend
